user.title: Add Sump Pump Monitor
user.description: Configure your first sump pump and its power monitor.

data_description.power_sensor: Select the sensor that reports the pump's electrical power in watts.
data_description.power_switch: Select the smart-plug switch entity if available. This lets the integration distinguish a switched-off monitor from an unavailable monitor.
data_description.high_power_percent: Alert when the current cycle's average draw exceeds the historical baseline by this percentage.
data_description.power_baseline_cycles: Number of recent completed cycles used to calculate the historical power baseline.
data_description.usage_window_hours: Rolling period used to evaluate heavy cycling.
data_description.heavy_cycling_percent: Alert when current cycling exceeds the historical expected cycling rate by this percentage.
data_description.min_historical_cycles: Minimum completed cycles required before heavy-cycling detection becomes active.
data_description.sensor_outage_minutes: How long the power sensor may be unavailable before an alert is sent.
data_description.notification_target: Select a notify entity, including a notification group helper.

abort.already_configured: Sump Pump Monitor is already configured.

error.invalid_entity: The selected entity is not valid.

menu_option_descriptions.notification: Choose the notify entity used for alerts.
menu_option_descriptions.history: Set how much completed cycle history is retained.

add_pump.title: Add pump
add_pump.description: Configure a sump pump and its power monitor.

data_description.power_sensor: The sensor that reports pump power in watts.
data_description.power_switch: The smart-plug switch entity. Optional, but recommended when the monitor can be switched off.
data_description.high_power_percent: Alert when current average cycle draw is this much higher than the historical baseline.
data_description.power_baseline_cycles: Recent completed cycles used for the historical power baseline.
data_description.usage_window_hours: Rolling period used to evaluate heavy cycling.
data_description.heavy_cycling_percent: Alert when cycling exceeds the historical expected rate by this percentage.
data_description.min_historical_cycles: Minimum completed cycles required before heavy-cycling detection activates.
data_description.sensor_outage_minutes: Delay before an unavailable power sensor generates an alert.

notification.title: Notification settings
notification.description: Choose the notify entity used for Sump Pump Monitor alerts. Notification group helpers can be selected here.

data_description.notification_target: Select a notify entity, including a notification group helper. Leave empty to disable notifications.

history.title: Cycle history settings
history.description: Completed cycles are stored persistently for each pump. Both limits are enforced.

abort.last_pump: At least one pump must remain configured.
abort.pump_not_found: The selected pump could not be found.
abort.edit_failed: The pump could not be edited.
